columns.COLUMN_COMMENT: Связь с отгулом для типов по уважительной причине

routines.ROUTINE_DEFINITION: BEGIN DECLARE assigned_owner BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET p_owner=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); SET p_owner=NULL; SELECT a.student_id,s.student_id INTO p_owner,assigned_owner FROM classic_exam_attempts a LEFT JOIN classic_exam_assignments s ON s.id=a.assignment_id WHERE a.id=p_attempt LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF p_owner IS NULL OR assigned_owner IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); CALL cpm_assert_student_write(assigned_owner); IF p_owner<>assigned_owner THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE assigned_owner BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET assigned_owner=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); SELECT student_id INTO assigned_owner FROM classic_exam_assignments WHERE id=p_assignment LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF assigned_owner IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(assigned_owner); IF assigned_owner<>p_owner THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_question_link(p_question,p_attempt); END

BEGIN DECLARE linked_owner BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET linked_owner=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); IF p_zap IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT student_id INTO linked_owner FROM zaps WHERE id=p_zap LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF linked_owner IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(linked_owner); IF linked_owner<>p_owner THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE job_status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET job_status=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); SET p_captured=FALSE; SET p_erasure=FALSE; SELECT j.status INTO job_status FROM student_deletion_jobs j JOIN student_deletion_barriers b ON b.job_id=j.id AND b.student_id=j.student_id WHERE JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.manifest_json,'$.command_ids'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(j.manifest_json,'$.command_ids'),CAST(p_command AS JSON)) LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF job_status IS NOT NULL THEN SET p_captured=TRUE; SET p_erasure=(BINARY job_status IN ('queued','running','waiting','failed')); END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE file_submission BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE file_key VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET file_submission=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); IF p_file IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT submission_id,object_key INTO file_submission,file_key FROM homework_submission_files WHERE id=p_file LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF file_submission IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF p_submission IS NULL OR p_submission<>file_submission THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_file_submission_conflict'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_object_write(file_key,p_owner,p_submission); END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET owner_id=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); SELECT student_id INTO owner_id FROM homework_submissions WHERE id=p_submission LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF owner_id IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_object_write(p_key,owner_id,p_submission); END

BEGIN DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE homework_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET owner_id=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); SELECT s.student_id,s.homework_id INTO owner_id,homework_id FROM homework_submissions s WHERE s.id=p_submission LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF owner_id IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(owner_id); IF owner_id<>p_owner OR homework_id<>p_homework THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_file_pointer(p_result,p_submission,p_owner); CALL cpm_assert_student_object_write(p_staging,p_owner,p_submission); CALL cpm_assert_student_object_write(p_processed,p_owner,p_submission); END

BEGIN DECLARE normalized JSON; DECLARE scalar_text LONGTEXT; DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; SET normalized=p_value; IF p_value IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(p_value)='STRING' THEN SET scalar_text=JSON_UNQUOTE(p_value); IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(scalar_text,'^[0-9]+$','c') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_json_id_invalid'; END IF; SET scalar_text=TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM scalar_text); IF scalar_text='' THEN SET scalar_text='0'; END IF; SET normalized=JSON_QUOTE(scalar_text); END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(normalized,FALSE,owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_write(owner_id); END

BEGIN DECLARE scalar_text VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT NULL; SET p_id=NULL; IF p_value IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(p_value)<>'NULL' THEN IF JSON_TYPE(p_value) NOT IN ('INTEGER','STRING') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_json_id_invalid'; END IF; SET scalar_text=JSON_UNQUOTE(p_value); IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(scalar_text, '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$', 'c') OR CHAR_LENGTH(scalar_text)>19 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_json_id_invalid'; END IF; IF CAST(scalar_text AS DECIMAL(20,0))>9223372036854775807 OR (scalar_text='0' AND NOT p_allow_zero) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_json_id_invalid'; END IF; SET p_id=CAST(scalar_text AS SIGNED); END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE paths JSON; DECLARE matches_json JSON; DECLARE value_json JSON; DECLARE path_index INT DEFAULT 0; DECLARE match_index INT DEFAULT 0; DECLARE item_index INT DEFAULT 0; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); SET paths=JSON_ARRAY('$**.student_id','$**.studentId','$**.studentID', '$**.existing_student_id','$**.target_student_id','$**.privilegeBaselineStudentId', '$**.student.id','$**.student_ids','$**.studentIds','$**.student_ids_created'); IF p_document IS NOT NULL THEN WHILE path_index<JSON_LENGTH(paths) DO SET matches_json=JSON_EXTRACT(p_document,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(paths,CONCAT('$[',path_index,']')))); SET match_index=0; WHILE matches_json IS NOT NULL AND match_index<JSON_LENGTH(matches_json) DO SET value_json=JSON_EXTRACT(matches_json,CONCAT('$[',match_index,']')); IF path_index<7 THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_journal_id(value_json); ELSEIF JSON_TYPE(value_json)<>'NULL' THEN IF JSON_TYPE(value_json)<>'ARRAY' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_json_id_invalid'; END IF; SET item_index=0; WHILE item_index<JSON_LENGTH(value_json) DO CALL cpm_assert_student_journal_id(JSON_EXTRACT(value_json,CONCAT('$[',item_index,']'))); SET item_index=item_index+1; END WHILE; END IF; SET match_index=match_index+1; END WHILE; SET path_index=path_index+1; END WHILE; END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE parent_owner BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE job_homework BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE parent_homework BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE job_submission BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE resolved_submission BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET owner_id=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); SET resolved_submission=p_submission; IF p_submission IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT student_id INTO owner_id FROM homework_submissions WHERE id=p_submission LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF owner_id IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(owner_id); IF owner_id<>p_owner THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; END IF; END IF; IF p_job IS NOT NULL THEN SET owner_id=NULL; SELECT j.student_id,j.submission_id,s.student_id,j.homework_id,s.homework_id INTO owner_id,job_submission,parent_owner,job_homework,parent_homework FROM homework_file_jobs j LEFT JOIN homework_submissions s ON s.id=j.submission_id WHERE BINARY j.id=BINARY p_job LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF owner_id IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(owner_id); IF owner_id<>p_owner OR (p_submission IS NOT NULL AND p_submission<>job_submission) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; IF parent_owner IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(parent_owner); IF parent_owner<>p_owner OR job_homework<>parent_homework THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; END IF; SET resolved_submission=job_submission; END IF; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_object_write(p_key,p_owner,resolved_submission); END

BEGIN DECLARE message_thread BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE sender_role VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE sender_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET message_thread=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); SELECT thread_id,m.sender_role,m.sender_id INTO message_thread,sender_role,sender_id FROM homework_chat_messages m WHERE id=p_message LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF message_thread IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF p_thread IS NOT NULL AND p_thread<>message_thread THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_thread_write(message_thread,p_owner); IF BINARY sender_role='system' AND sender_id IS NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); ELSE CALL cpm_assert_student_role_write(sender_role,sender_id,p_owner); END IF; END

BEGIN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); SET p_owner=p_student; IF p_student IS NOT NULL AND p_student<1 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_invalid'; END IF; IF p_thread IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_thread_write(p_thread,p_owner); IF p_student IS NOT NULL AND p_student<>p_owner THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_role_write(p_role,p_recipient,p_owner); IF BINARY p_role='student' THEN SET p_owner=p_recipient; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); END

BEGIN DECLARE hit_key VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE referenced_owner BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET hit_key=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_owner); IF p_key IS NOT NULL THEN IF p_key='' OR p_owner IS NULL OR p_owner<1 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_object_owner_invalid'; END IF; SET hit_key=NULL; SELECT o.object_key,o.student_id INTO hit_key,referenced_owner FROM homework_object_ownership o WHERE BINARY o.object_key=BINARY p_key AND (o.student_id<>p_owner OR (o.submission_id IS NOT NULL AND p_submission IS NOT NULL AND o.submission_id<>p_submission)) LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF hit_key IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(referenced_owner); SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_object_owner_conflict'; END IF; SET hit_key=NULL; SELECT f.object_key,s.student_id INTO hit_key,referenced_owner FROM homework_submission_files f LEFT JOIN homework_submissions s ON s.id=f.submission_id WHERE BINARY f.object_key=BINARY p_key AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.student_id<>p_owner OR (p_submission IS NOT NULL AND f.submission_id<>p_submission)) LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF hit_key IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(referenced_owner); SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_object_owner_conflict'; END IF; SET hit_key=NULL; SELECT j.id,j.student_id INTO hit_key,referenced_owner FROM homework_file_jobs j LEFT JOIN homework_submissions s ON s.id=j.submission_id WHERE (BINARY j.staging_key=BINARY p_key OR BINARY j.processed_output_key=BINARY p_key) AND (s.id IS NULL OR j.student_id<>p_owner OR s.student_id<>p_owner OR j.homework_id<>s.homework_id OR (p_submission IS NOT NULL AND j.submission_id<>p_submission)) LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF hit_key IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(referenced_owner); SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_object_owner_conflict'; END IF; SET hit_key=NULL; SELECT o.object_key,p.student_id INTO hit_key,referenced_owner FROM homework_student_purge_objects o LEFT JOIN homework_student_purges p ON BINARY p.job_id=BINARY o.job_id WHERE BINARY o.object_key=BINARY p_key AND (p.job_id IS NULL OR p.student_id<>p_owner) LIMIT 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF hit_key IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(referenced_owner); SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_object_owner_conflict'; END IF; END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE linked_owner BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE object_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE payload_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE actor_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE homework_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE stored_homework BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE linked_thread BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE room_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE role_name VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE room_role VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE room_text VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE job_id VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE document JSON; DECLARE data_value JSON; DECLARE job_value JSON; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET linked_owner=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); IF p_payload IS NULL THEN SET document=JSON_OBJECT(); ELSE SET document=p_payload; END IF; IF JSON_TYPE(document)<>'OBJECT' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; IF p_thread IS NOT NULL THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_thread_write(p_thread,owner_id); END IF; IF BINARY p_event='message.created' THEN IF JSON_LENGTH(document)<>0 THEN IF JSON_LENGTH(document)<>1 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(document,'all','$.message_id') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.message_id'),FALSE,payload_id); IF payload_id IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; END IF; IF p_entity IS NOT NULL AND payload_id IS NOT NULL AND p_entity<>payload_id THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; SET object_id=COALESCE(p_entity,payload_id); IF object_id IS NULL OR object_id<1 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_message_write(object_id,p_thread,linked_owner); ELSEIF BINARY p_event='message.read' THEN IF p_thread IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF JSON_LENGTH(document)<>0 THEN IF JSON_LENGTH(document)<>3 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(document,'all','$.reader_role','$.reader_id','$.last_message_id') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.reader_id'),FALSE,actor_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_role_write(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.reader_role')),actor_id,owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.last_message_id'),TRUE,payload_id); IF payload_id IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; END IF; IF p_entity IS NOT NULL AND payload_id IS NOT NULL AND p_entity<>payload_id THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; SET object_id=COALESCE(p_entity,payload_id); IF object_id IS NULL OR object_id<0 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF object_id<>0 THEN CALL cpm_assert_student_message_write(object_id,p_thread,linked_owner); END IF; ELSEIF BINARY p_event='typing.changed' THEN IF p_thread IS NULL OR p_entity IS NOT NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(document)<>4 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(document,'all','$.actor_role','$.actor_id','$.active','$.expires_in_ms') OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.active'))<>'BOOLEAN' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.actor_id'),FALSE,actor_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_role_write(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.actor_role')),actor_id,owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.expires_in_ms'),FALSE,payload_id); IF payload_id IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; ELSEIF BINARY p_event IN ('submission.changed','job.progress','notification.created') THEN IF p_thread IS NOT NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(document)<>2 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(document,'all','$.room','$.data') OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.room'))<>'STRING' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.data'))<>'OBJECT' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; SET room_text=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.room')); IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(room_text,'^user:(student|admin|proctor|examinator|supervisor|staff_admin):[1-9][0-9]*$','c') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_room_invalid'; END IF; SET room_role=SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(room_text,':',2),':',-1); CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_QUOTE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(room_text,':',-1)),FALSE,room_id); SET data_value=JSON_EXTRACT(document,'$.data'); IF BINARY p_event='submission.changed' THEN IF BINARY room_role<>'student' OR JSON_LENGTH(data_value)<>3 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(data_value,'all','$.homework_id','$.student_id','$.submission_id') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value,'$.student_id'),FALSE,owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value,'$.homework_id'),FALSE,homework_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value,'$.submission_id'),FALSE,payload_id); IF owner_id IS NULL OR homework_id IS NULL OR NOT (p_entity<=>payload_id) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; IF payload_id IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT student_id,s.homework_id INTO linked_owner,stored_homework FROM homework_submissions s WHERE id=payload_id LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF linked_owner IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF owner_id<>linked_owner OR homework_id<>stored_homework THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; END IF; ELSEIF BINARY p_event='job.progress' THEN IF BINARY room_role<>'student' OR p_entity IS NOT NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(data_value)<>1 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(data_value,'all','$.job') OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value,'$.job'))<>'OBJECT' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; SET job_value=JSON_EXTRACT(data_value,'$.job'); IF JSON_LENGTH(job_value)<>6 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(job_value,'all','$.id','$.homework_id','$.status','$.stage','$.progress','$.error_code') OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.id'))<>'STRING' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.status'))<>'STRING' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.stage'))<>'STRING' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.progress'))<>'INTEGER' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.error_code')) NOT IN ('NULL','STRING') OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.status'))='' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.stage'))='' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.progress'),TRUE,payload_id); IF payload_id IS NULL OR payload_id>100 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; SET job_id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.id')); IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(job_id,'^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$','c') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(job_value,'$.homework_id'),FALSE,homework_id); SELECT j.student_id,j.homework_id,s.student_id INTO linked_owner,stored_homework,owner_id FROM homework_file_jobs j JOIN homework_submissions s ON s.id=j.submission_id WHERE BINARY j.id=BINARY job_id LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF linked_owner IS NULL OR owner_id IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF homework_id IS NULL OR homework_id<>stored_homework OR owner_id<>linked_owner THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; ELSE IF JSON_LENGTH(data_value)<>1 OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(data_value,'all','$.entity_id') THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_payload_invalid'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_json_id(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value,'$.entity_id'),FALSE,payload_id); IF payload_id IS NULL OR NOT (p_entity<=>payload_id) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; SET role_name=NULL; SELECT recipient_role,recipient_id,student_id,thread_id INTO role_name,actor_id,linked_owner,linked_thread FROM notifications WHERE id=payload_id LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF role_name IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; IF BINARY room_role<>BINARY role_name OR room_id<>actor_id THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_notification_write(role_name,actor_id,linked_owner,linked_thread,owner_id); END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_role_write(room_role,room_id,owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_write(owner_id); ELSE SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_outbox_event_unknown'; END IF; END
BEGIN DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_attempt_owner(p_attempt,owner_id); CALL cpm_assert_student_question_link(p_replaces,p_attempt); END

BEGIN DECLARE linked_attempt BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET linked_attempt=NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); IF p_question IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT attempt_id INTO linked_attempt FROM classic_exam_presented_questions WHERE id=p_question LOCK IN SHARE MODE; IF linked_attempt IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_attempt_owner(linked_attempt,owner_id); IF p_attempt IS NULL OR linked_attempt<>p_attempt THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_question_attempt_conflict'; END IF; END IF; END

BEGIN CALL cpm_assert_student_write(NULL); IF p_role IS NULL OR BINARY p_role NOT IN ('student','admin','proctor','examinator','supervisor','staff_admin') OR p_id IS NULL OR p_id<1 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_role_invalid'; END IF; IF BINARY p_role='student' THEN IF p_owner IS NOT NULL AND p_owner<>p_id THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_conflict'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_write(p_id); END IF; END

BEGIN DECLARE owner_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL; CALL cpm_assert_student_attempt_owner(p_attempt,owner_id); IF p_question IS NULL THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='student_write_owner_missing'; END IF; CALL cpm_assert_student_question_link(p_question,p_attempt); END
